# Adaptive white noise IC 

## Simulation Setting

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

grid <- expand.grid(
  T = c(1000, 2000, 5000),
  p = c(0, 1, 2),
  q = c(0, 1, 2),
  ar_strength = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9),
  ma_strength = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9)
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(p == 0 & q == 0)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ar_strength = ifelse(p == 0, 0, ar_strength),

  Npc = 1,
  lag_test = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05
)

res_compare$simple_result %>% filter(method == "Adaptive_IC") %>% pull(correct) %>% mean()
```

### Helper to get auto-search
```{r}
auto_select_one_from_IC_detail <- function(df,
                                           sample_size,
                                           p_max = 5,
                                           q_max = 5) {
  if (!"converged" %in% names(df)) {
    df$converged <- TRUE
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(p), !is.na(q), is.finite(F_T), converged == TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        p_auto = NA_integer_,
        q_auto = NA_integer_,
        delta_hat_auto = NA_real_,
        IC_auto = NA_real_,
        auto_path = NA_character_
      )
    )
  }
  
  big_fit <- df %>%
    filter(p == p_max, q == q_max) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  if (nrow(big_fit) == 0 || !is.finite(big_fit$F_T)) {
    return(
      tibble(
        p_auto = NA_integer_,
        q_auto = NA_integer_,
        delta_hat_auto = NA_real_,
        IC_auto = NA_real_,
        auto_path = NA_character_
      )
    )
  }
  
  delta_hat <- big_fit$F_T[1]
  
  df_auto <- df %>%
    mutate(
      delta_hat_auto = delta_hat,
      penalty_auto = log(log(sample_size)) * delta_hat_auto * (p + q),
      IC_auto_candidate = F_T + penalty_auto
    )
  
  starts <- tibble(p = c(2, 1, 0), q = c(2, 0, 1)) %>%
    filter(p <= p_max, q <= q_max, !(p == 0 & q == 0))
  
  start_results <- df_auto %>%
    inner_join(starts, by = c("p", "q")) %>%
    filter(is.finite(IC_auto_candidate))
  
  if (nrow(start_results) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        p_auto = NA_integer_,
        q_auto = NA_integer_,
        delta_hat_auto = delta_hat,
        IC_auto = NA_real_,
        auto_path = NA_character_
      )
    )
  }
  
  current <- start_results %>%
    slice_min(IC_auto_candidate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  
  current_p <- as.integer(current$p)
  current_q <- as.integer(current$q)
  current_IC <- as.numeric(current$IC_auto_candidate)
  
  path <- paste0("(", current_p, ",", current_q, ")")
  
  improved <- TRUE
  
  while (improved) {
    improved <- FALSE
    
    neighbours <- expand.grid(dp = c(-1, 0, 1), dq = c(-1, 0, 1)) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      filter(!(dp == 0 & dq == 0)) %>%
      mutate(p = current_p + dp, q = current_q + dq) %>%
      filter(p >= 0, q >= 0, p <= p_max, q <= q_max, !(p == 0 &
                                                         q == 0)) %>%
      select(p, q) %>%
      distinct()
    
    neighbour_results <- df_auto %>%
      inner_join(neighbours, by = c("p", "q")) %>%
      filter(is.finite(IC_auto_candidate))
    
    if (nrow(neighbour_results) > 0) {
      best_neighbour <- neighbour_results %>%
        slice_min(IC_auto_candidate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
      
      if (best_neighbour$IC_auto_candidate < current_IC) {
        current_p <- as.integer(best_neighbour$p)
        current_q <- as.integer(best_neighbour$q)
        current_IC <- as.numeric(best_neighbour$IC_auto_candidate)
        
        path <- paste0(path, " -> (", current_p, ",", current_q, ")")
        
        improved <- TRUE
      }
    }
  }
  
  tibble(
    p_auto = current_p,
    q_auto = current_q,
    delta_hat_auto = delta_hat,
    IC_auto = current_IC,
    auto_path = path
  )
}

make_auto_result_from_IC_detail <- function(IC_detail,
                                            p_max = 5,
                                            q_max = 5) {
  candidate_cols <- c("p", "q", "F_T", "IC", "penalty", "converged", "delta_hat")
  
  grid_result_cols <- c("p_hat", "q_hat", "correct_selected")
  
  group_cols <- setdiff(names(IC_detail), c(candidate_cols, grid_result_cols))
  
  IC_detail %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      df_i <- .x
      key_i <- .y
      
      sample_size <- if ("n" %in% names(key_i)) {
        key_i$n[[1]]
      } else if ("T" %in% names(key_i)) {
        key_i$T[[1]]
      } else {
        stop("No sample size column found in group key.")
      }
      
      grid_best <- df_i %>%
        filter(is.finite(IC)) %>%
        slice_min(IC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
        transmute(p_grid = as.integer(p),
                  q_grid = as.integer(q),
                  IC_grid = as.numeric(IC))
      
      if (nrow(grid_best) == 0) {
        grid_best <- tibble(p_grid = NA_integer_,
                            q_grid = NA_integer_,
                            IC_grid = NA_real_)
      }
      
      auto_best <- auto_select_one_from_IC_detail(
        df = df_i,
        sample_size = sample_size,
        p_max = p_max,
        q_max = q_max
      )
      
      bind_cols(grid_best, auto_best)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(same_grid_auto = p_grid == p_auto & q_grid == q_auto) %>%
    mutate(grid_correct = if ("p_true" %in% names(.) &&
                              "q_true" %in% names(.)) {
      p_grid == p_true & q_grid == q_true
    } else {
      NA
    },
    auto_correct = if ("p_true" %in% names(.) &&
                       "q_true" %in% names(.)) {
      p_auto == p_true & q_auto == q_true
    } else {
      NA
    })
}

make_order_accuracy_summary <- function(df)
{
  library(dplyr)

  correct_name <- if ("correct_selected" %in% names(df)) {
    "correct_selected"
  } else if ("correct" %in% names(df)) {
    "correct"
  } else {
    stop("Need `correct_selected` or `correct` column.")
  }

  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need `T` or `n` column.")
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      correct_use = as.numeric(.data[[correct_name]]),

      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),

      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),

      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      model_label = paste0("FARMA(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),

      model_class = case_when(
        p_true > 0 & q_true == 0 ~ "Pure FAR",
        p_true == 0 & q_true > 0 ~ "Pure FMA",
        p_true > 0 & q_true > 0 ~ "FARMA",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),

      method = case_when(
        as.character(method) %in%
          c("WN_Test", "WN test", "Box Jenkins") ~
          "Box Jenkins",

        as.character(method) %in%
          c("Adaptive_IC", "Adaptive IC", "Functional IC") ~
          "Functional IC",

        as.character(method) %in%
          c(
            "Adaptive_IC_auto",
            "Adaptive IC auto",
            "Auto Adaptive IC",
            "Auto Functional IC"
          ) ~
          "Auto Functional IC",

        TRUE ~ as.character(method)
      )
    ) %>%

    group_by(
      T_value,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_label,
      model_class,
      method
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      accuracy = mean(correct_use, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_runs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      T_factor = factor(
        T_value,
        levels = sort(unique(T_value))
      ),

      method = factor(
        method,
        levels = c(
          "Box Jenkins",
          "Functional IC",
          "Auto Functional IC"
        )
      ),

      model_class = factor(
        model_class,
        levels = c(
          "Pure FAR",
          "Pure FMA",
          "FARMA",
          "Other"
        )
      ),

      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)", "(2,0)",
          "(0,1)", "(0,2)",
          "(1,1)", "(2,1)",
          "(1,2)", "(2,2)"
        )
      ),

      psi_label = factor(
        paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi==",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      ),

      nu_label = factor(
        paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "nu==",
          sort(unique(ma_strength))
        )
      ),

      psi_plain = factor(
        ar_strength,
        levels = sort(unique(ar_strength))
      ),

      nu_plain = factor(
        ma_strength,
        levels = sort(unique(ma_strength))
      )
    )
}
```

### Plotting functions
```{r}
plot_order_accuracy_one_model <- function(df, model_show, title = NULL, show_legend = FALSE)
{
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(model == model_show)

  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)
  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]
  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])

  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = T_factor,
      y = accuracy,
      group = method,
      colour = method,
      linetype = method,
      shape = method
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
    geom_point(size = 2.0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1.02),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      colour = "Method",
      linetype = "Method",
      shape = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2.5, "pt"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.65, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )

  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g + facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g + facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g + facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }

  g
}

make_method_legend <- function() {
  methods <- c("Box Jenkins", "Functional IC", "Auto Functional IC")

  make_custom_method_legend(
    methods = methods,
    colours = method_cols,
    linetypes = method_ltys,
    shapes = method_shapes,
    labels = methods,
    title = "Order selection",
    base_size = 18,
    point_size = 3,
    line_width = 0.9
  )
}

combine_four_models_shared_axes <- function(
    df,
    models,
    titles,
    file_name = NULL,
    width = 16,
    height = 12
) {
  
  legend <- make_method_legend()
  
  p1 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model(df, models[1], titles[1], show_legend = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  p2 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model(df, models[2], titles[2], show_legend = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  p3 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model(df, models[3], titles[3], show_legend = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  p4 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model(df, models[4], titles[4], show_legend = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p1, p2,
    p3, p4,
    ncol = 2,
    align = "hv",
    axis = "tblr"
  )
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.075,
      y = 0.08,
      width = 0.91,
      height = 0.90
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Selection accuracy",
      x = 0.018,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = 20
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Sample size T",
      x = 0.53,
      y = 0.02,
      size = 20
    )
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.06, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

# 2,1 case
```{r}
compute_pi_FARMA <- function(
    ref = 101,
    p,
    q,
    ar_strength = 0.6,
    ma_strength = 0.6,
    lag_strength = "equal",
    max_lag = 10
) {

  if (p < 0 || q < 0) {
    stop("p and q must be non-negative.")
  }

  if (p == 0 && q == 0) {
    stop("At least one of p or q must be positive.")
  }

  zero_mat <- matrix(0, ref, ref)

  if (p > 0) {
    Phi_kernel_list <- generate_AR_kernels(
      ref = ref,
      p = p,
      ar_strength = ar_strength,
      lag_strength = lag_strength
    )

    Phi_list <- lapply(
      Phi_kernel_list,
      function(A) A / ref
    )
  } else {
    Phi_list <- list()
  }

  if (q > 0) {
    Theta_kernel_list <- generate_MA_kernels(
      ref = ref,
      q = q,
      ma_strength = ma_strength,
      lag_strength = lag_strength
    )

    Theta_list <- lapply(
      Theta_kernel_list,
      function(A) A / ref
    )
  } else {
    Theta_list <- list()
  }

  get_Phi <- function(k) {
    if (k <= p) Phi_list[[k]] else zero_mat
  }

  get_Theta <- function(k) {
    if (k <= q) Theta_list[[k]] else zero_mat
  }

  Pi_list <- vector("list", max_lag)

  for (k in seq_len(max_lag)) {

    Pi_k <- get_Phi(k) + get_Theta(k)

    if (q > 0 && k >= 2) {
      for (j in seq_len(min(q, k - 1))) {
        Pi_k <-
          Pi_k -
          Theta_list[[j]] %*% Pi_list[[k - j]]
      }
    }

    Pi_list[[k]] <- Pi_k
  }

  summary_table <- data.frame(
    lag = seq_len(max_lag),
    spectral_norm = vapply(
      Pi_list,
      function(A) norm(A, type = "2"),
      numeric(1)
    ),
    hilbert_schmidt_norm = vapply(
      Pi_list,
      function(A) norm(A, type = "F"),
      numeric(1)
    )
  )

  list(
    Phi = Phi_list,
    Theta = Theta_list,
    Pi = Pi_list,
    summary = summary_table
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

simple_result <- order_select_comapre$simple_result
IC_detail <- order_select_comapre$IC_detail

target_simple <- simple_result %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method == "Adaptive_IC",
    dplyr::near(ar_strength, 0.8),
    dplyr::near(ma_strength, 0.5),
    p_true == 2,
    q_true %in% c(1, 2)
  )

target_ic <- IC_detail %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dplyr::near(ar_strength, 0.8),
    dplyr::near(ma_strength, 0.5),
    p_true == 2,
    q_true %in% c(1, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    true_model = paste0("FARMA(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
    candidate = paste0("FARMA(", p, ",", q, ")"),
    total_order = p + q,
    true_total_order = p_true + q_true
  )

selection_frequency <- target_simple %>%
  dplyr::count(
    n,
    p_true,
    q_true,
    p_hat,
    q_hat,
    name = "frequency"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    n,
    p_true,
    q_true
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = frequency / sum(frequency)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    p_true,
    q_true,
    n,
    dplyr::desc(proportion)
  )

    n,
    p_true,
    q_true
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_success = sum(!is.na(correct)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    p_true,
    q_true,
    n
  )

accuracy_by_T

candidate_summary <- target_ic %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n == 5000,
    (
      p_true == 2 & q_true == 1 &
        (
          (p == 1 & q == 1) |
          (p == 2 & q == 0) |
          (p == 1 & q == 2) |
          (p == 3 & q == 0) |
          (p == 2 & q == 1) |
          (p == 2 & q == 2)
        )
    ) |
      (
        p_true == 2 & q_true == 2 &
          (
            (p == 1 & q == 3) |
            (p == 4 & q == 0) |
            (p == 1 & q == 2) |
            (p == 2 & q == 1) |
            (p == 3 & q == 1) |
            (p == 2 & q == 2)
          )
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    true_model,
    candidate,
    p,
    q,
    total_order
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_F_T = mean(F_T, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_F_T = sd(F_T, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_penalty = mean(penalty, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_IC = mean(IC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_IC = sd(IC, na.rm = TRUE),
    convergence_rate = mean(converged, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    true_model,
    mean_IC
  )

candidate_summary

best_raw_fit_frequency <- target_ic %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n == 5000,
    is.finite(F_T),
    converged == TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    true_model,
    seed
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(
    F_T,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::count(
    true_model,
    candidate,
    name = "frequency",
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(true_model) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = frequency / sum(frequency)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

best_raw_fit_frequency

penalty_by_T <- target_ic %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    penalty_unit = log(log(n)) * delta_hat
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    n,
    true_model,
    seed
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    delta_hat = dplyr::first(delta_hat),
    penalty_unit = dplyr::first(penalty_unit),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    n,
    true_model
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_delta_hat = mean(delta_hat, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_delta_hat = sd(delta_hat, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_penalty_unit = mean(penalty_unit, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_penalty_unit = sd(penalty_unit, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rep = dplyr::n_distinct(seed),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    true_model,
    n
  )

penalty_by_T

true_fit_gap <- target_ic %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n == 5000,
    is.finite(F_T),
    converged == TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    true_model,
    seed
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    true_F_T = F_T[
      p == p_true &
        q == q_true
    ][1],
    true_IC = IC[
      p == p_true &
        q == q_true
    ][1]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !(p == p_true & q == q_true)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    true_model,
    seed
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    best_competing_F_T = min(F_T, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_competing_IC = min(IC, na.rm = TRUE),
    true_F_T = dplyr::first(true_F_T),
    true_IC = dplyr::first(true_IC),
    FT_gap_true_minus_best =
      true_F_T - best_competing_F_T,
    IC_gap_true_minus_best =
      true_IC - best_competing_IC,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

true_fit_gap_summary <- true_fit_gap %>%
  dplyr::group_by(true_model) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_FT_gap_true_minus_best =
      mean(FT_gap_true_minus_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_IC_gap_true_minus_best =
      mean(IC_gap_true_minus_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    proportion_true_has_best_F_T =
      mean(FT_gap_true_minus_best < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    proportion_true_has_best_IC =
      mean(IC_gap_true_minus_best < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

true_fit_gap_summary

ggplot(
  candidate_summary,
  aes(
    x = candidate,
    y = mean_F_T,
    group = 1
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ true_model,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Candidate model",
    y = "Mean fit term"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```
